This file holds ALL text shown on the site. Edit the values, not the keys. Every entry has an English (en) and Chinese (zh) version — keep both filled in. You can use simple HTML inside the text:
makes a line break, and & is the & symbol. Don't rename keys or remove commas/quotes/brackets. After editing, save and redeploy.

metaDescription.en: Josephine Shen — research and strategy at the meeting point of AI, security, and the state.
metaDescription.zh: 沈约瑟芬——研究与战略，立于人工智能、安全与国家的交汇之处。

eyebrow.en: Research & strategy / AI · security · the state
eyebrow.zh: 研究与战略 / 人工智能 · 安全 · 国家

hero.zh: 工作于治国之道与计算的交汇之处。

about_p1.en: I work across the whole body of technology governance — not a single domain — connecting the right people on the right problems. My work is deliberately interdisciplinary: I pull together vocabularies from fields that rarely speak, and build the talent to tackle them.
about_p1.zh: 我关注技术治理的整体——而非单一领域——把合适的人聚到合适的议题上。我的工作有意跨越学科：把鲜少对话的领域的语汇汇聚到一起，并培养能应对这些问题的人才。

about_p2.en: It is international in scope, with working access across Europe and China, and grounded in commercial ML experience with European companies — close to AI weapons proliferation and the questions it raises. I make change at the level of systems.
about_p2.zh: 工作范围具国际性，在欧洲与中国均有实际接触，并以同欧洲企业合作的商业机器学习经验为基础——贴近人工智能武器扩散及其引发的问题。我在系统层面推动改变。

fig_caption.en: The technology–policy stack. Work concentrates at the governance layer — the interface where infrastructure, capability, and the state meet.
fig_caption.zh: 技术—政策栈。工作集中于治理层——基础设施、能力与国家相交的界面。
